scripts.dev: npm run build -w @stockflow/shared && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @stockflow/web" "npm run dev -w @stockflow/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stockflow/shared && npm run build -w @stockflow/api && npm run build -w @stockflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @stockflow/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
